cohort: Nondiabetic, older adults from the Microbiome and Insulin Longitudinal Evaluation Study (MILES)
finding: Compared to vaginal delivery, Cesarean delivery was associated with higher BMI, fasting glucose, and a decreased insulin sensitivity, ultimately leading to an increased risk of prediabetes and diabetes.
